title: Protocol: Non‐invasive management strategies for molar‐incisor hypomineralization (MIH) in children
html:
Authors: Prachi Kumari, Kanika Singh Dhull, Sharon R Lewis, Brahmananda Dutta, Anandamoy Bagchi, Neeraj Gugnani, Jugajyoti Pathi, Dhirendra Kumar Singh, Nivedita Sahoo, Lipsa Bhuyan

We will look at the benefits and harms of non‐invasive management strategies for molar incisor hypomineralization (MIH) in children aged six to 14 years.

The protocol for this review has recently been published in the Cochrane Library, and we have now started work on this review.
